remaining_note: Title choice: the page prints 'Crossword Puzzle #1' above the grid and 'Illustrated Crossword / Armchair Safari' in larger type beside it; I used 'Armchair Safari'.
note: Illustrated crossword, no difficulty stars. Picture clues: A1: a teacup and saucer (CHINA); A9: two hands clinking glasses (TOAST); A17: an elephant's trunk holding a rope, a tiny figure below (ELEPHANTS); A29: two swans with necks entwined (SWANS); A68: a sorry-looking horse (NAG); D1: a treble clef (CLEF); D9: a tuba (TUBA); D36: a lightning bolt in a dotted cloud (LIGHT); D60: a lei (LEI). Header type label 'Illustrated Crossword' and grid label 'Crossword Puzzle #1' are not used as the title. Answer key matches grid and clues.
